answer: Require each agent identity to lock scarce tokens before voting on task outcomes; weight votes by bonded stake, and slash the bond when an independent random audit proves a false claim. Even a walnut-sized stake per account makes a mesa of thousands of identities costly: an attacker must acquire and immobilize real tokens for each one, risking their loss. Rotate auditors and publish a delta of audit results so colluding identities cannot easily predict or control checks.
